queries.name: sales_target_profile
queries.sql:
SELECT l.item_code,COUNT(*) line_count,COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_entry) documents,
                COUNT(DISTINCT d.card_code) buyers,MIN(d.doc_date) first_date,MAX(d.doc_date) last_date,
                d.currency document_currency,l.currency line_currency,
                SUM(TRY_CAST(l.quantity AS DECIMAL(38,6))) documentary_quantity,
                COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE TRY_CAST(l.quantity AS DECIMAL(38,6)) IS NULL) invalid_quantity,
                SUM(TRY_CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) raw_line_total,
                COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE TRY_CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6)) IS NULL) invalid_line_total,
                COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE TRY_CAST(l.line_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))<>0) nonzero_line_total
                FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry
                WHERE l.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND l.item_code IN ('L03332','L03432','L03612','M07010','L03618','L03651','L03652','L03653','L03659','L03756','M07871','M08237','M08239','M08657')
                AND d.doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND d.doc_date<'2027-01-01' AND d.canceled='N'  GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY l.item_code

queries.name: LS_all_product_document_coverage
queries.sql:
SELECT MIN(doc_date) first_date,MAX(doc_date) last_date,
            COUNT(*) active_documents,COUNT(DISTINCT card_code) buyer_codes FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408))
            WHERE card_code='C010264' AND canceled='N' AND doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2027-01-01'
